data.title: Expo Golf Villas 6
data.about:
Welcome to Expo Golf Villas 6, the latest phase in Emaar South. 

Offering you an amazing collection of 3 & 4 bedroom villas with ample space. This project offers you the highest form of elite lifestyle, the best of amenities and more. They are elegantly designed homes and offer you a tranquil space to call your own.

location_tile.title: An Ideal Location
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Located in Emaar South, Expo Golf Villas 6, is just minutes from the site of Expo 2020 in Dubai. The residents can enjoy the fantastic golf course and more.

  • 07 mins – Al Maktoum International Airport
  • 30 mins – Downtown Dubai
  • 50 mins – Abu Dhabi
  • 10 mins – Expo 2020 Dubai site
  • 20 mins – Dubai Marina
